title: The Team
description: The Safety Game is organized by the Models in Decision Making and Data Analysis (MIND) research lab of the Department of Informatics, Systems, and Communication at the University of Milano-Bicocca.

Elisabetta Fersini.bio: Her research focuses primarily on machine learning and natural language processing, with specific interests in hate speech detection, information extraction and topic modelling.

Giulia Rizzi.bio: Giulia Rizzi is a postdoc researcher. She obtained a Ph.D. in Computer Science at Università degli Studi di Milano - Bicocca (UniMiB) and at Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV). Her research interests are centered in the field of Natural Language Processing and machine learning.

Giuseppe Magazzù.bio: Giuseppe Magazzù is a 2nd year PhD student. His research focuses on developing an ethical framework and implementing safety strategies to ensure that large language models generate safe, useful, and high-quality outputs.

Daniel Scalena.bio: Daniel Scalena is a 3rd year PhD student in a cotutelle agreement with University of Groningen. His research focuses mainly on the interpretability of language models.
